message: Hand the name to the control
$reason: A stop handed the name around a `<ul role="menu">` whose items are projected — `pct-menu`'s panel, one element too low. The menu takes no focus and is a control all the same: a composite, which `insideOf` counts beside the widgets and the windows, by the role written on it and not by the list its tag would be. axe reports `aria-prohibited-attr` on the stop in three engines.
